input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Arizona, without regard to the conflict of laws provisions thereof.
input.rationale: The agreement selects Arizona law, which is outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales), and specifies no court venue. Section 19 further mandates binding arbitration of all disputes under U.S. Arbitration & Mediation rules, whereas our position requires resolution in courts. We therefore changed the governing law to New York and substituted exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County for the arbitration forum, leaving the remainder of both clauses intact. Not a walk-away, as the arbitration seat is domestic rather than foreign.

proposal.summary: Change governing law from Arizona to New York and replace mandatory arbitration with exclusive jurisdiction of the New York County courts.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have moved governing law from Arizona to New York and replaced binding arbitration with the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, consistent with our standard position that disputes be resolved in court under New York law. If New York is difficult, we can accept Delaware or California law and courts as a fallback.

Each party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York for all disputes arising out of or relating to this Agreement.

ops.oldText: will be subject to and resolved by binding arbitration pursuant to the Arbitration Rules of U.S. Arbitration & Mediation, (www.usam.com). Any award or order rendered by the arbitrator may be confirmed as a judgment or order in any state or federal court of competent jurisdiction, which includes within the federal judicial district of the residence of the party against whom such award or order was entered.
